STRATEGY: L can't reach 2 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). I follow exactly 1 place of each kind (East, gazette, clips, forum, foreign). If L pins 3 of my places, pool = 55000 x ~0.016, which is under 1000, so I'm caught. If he pins only 2, pool is about 2750-3400, which is safe. GOAL: find ONE reachable kind, DROP it forever (never kill any victim that lists that place), then kill national + all victims from the other 4 places every day = 9/day. Over 5 days that is 45, which is at least 40, so x4. A dropped place must never reach 3 successful traces (2 is ok). Always use quick entries in the AFTERNOON (night worker; this keeps students, home and night workers in the pool, so pool about 55000 before traces). Never use the morning. Timed entries also go in the afternoon. Avoid any victim that lists a dropped place, even if it also lists a kept place.
DAY 1 TEST (all deaths traced since there are 5 or fewer): killed d1-3 national, d1-1 and d1-6 gazette (sector), d1-9 clips (age). The deaths_traced increase after day 1 decodes as: 0 means sector and age are both unreachable, so East, forum and foreign are reachable; drop one of those (e.g. forum) and keep gazette, clips and the other two. 2 or 3 means gazette (sector) is reachable, so DROP gazette and keep East, clips, forum, foreign. 1 is ambiguous: most likely clips reachable and gazette not (~80%), but possibly gazette reachable with one trace failing. In that case run another clean test (e.g. 2 gazette + national only, or 2 gazette + 2 from one other kind) before committing. Watch the pool: expect about 55000, then about 13000 after L pins 1 place, then about 3000 after 2 places. It should stay around 3000.

- 1 or 2 means gazette is REACHABLE. DROP GAZETTE forever. Keep East, clips, forum, foreign. Gazette then has up to 2-3 traces; never kill gazette again.
FROM DAY 3: kill national + 8 victims from the 4 kept places daily (9 kills, quick, afternoon). Skip any victim that lists the dropped place.
